decisions.thought: Bring Garchomp with Focus Sash to lead and set Stealth Rock, since it outspeeds most of their team. Gholdengo blocks status and provides strong special offense, while Kingambit handles Venusaur and Torkoal with Supreme Overlord power.

Torkoal's Drought enables Venusaur's Chlorophyll for a fast sun sweep, and Gholdengo handles Sylveon with Steel STAB while checking Dragonite. This trio covers the opponent's Fairy and Dragon threats well.
